capabilities: Opt in individual notes via a wordCountTracked marker command
Write wordCount and readingTimeMinutes frontmatter properties
Recount tracked notes after edits with debounced writes
Detect and refuse conflicts with existing foreign property values
Show a Pro rendered-text reading preview that skips frontmatter, code and syntax
disambiguation: Unlike Novel Word Count, it shows no live counts in the editor or file explorer; it only writes per-note properties for use in Bases.
extras: Freemium: free per-note counting; Pro ($15 one-time or $5/month via GitHub Sponsors) adds a rendered-text reading preview. The README warns that core-API frontmatter writes can normalize YAML formatting. A What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and links to notemods.com; the plugin is not staff-reviewed.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count is only displayed, not stored as a note property, so Bases cannot sort, group or summarize notes by length or reading time.

relations.evidence: Novel Word Count displays file explorer statistics.
Auto Properties can generate frontmatter, including word counts and reading time.

summary: Writes numeric wordCount and readingTimeMinutes properties to opted-in notes so Bases tables can sort, filter and summarize them.
